name: BBQ Turkey Meatballs with Mashed Potatoes & Tangy Coleslaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium red potatoes
1 ½ lemons
3 medium carrots
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Peel and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to the pot.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with turkey, bread crumbs, chili powder, and salt. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
2 tbsp chili powder
salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a large plate.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a clean plate.
Once the meatballs have been removed, return the pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar, and spices; stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is simmering, return meatballs to the pot and turn to coat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the meatballs are cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into another large bowl; add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the root end of each cabbage; halve cabbages lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the coleslaw.
Add milk, oil, salt, and pepper to the pot with the potatoes and mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 fl oz (¾ cup) whole milk
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mashed potatoes, coleslaw, and saucy meatballs between plates. Enjoy!
